title: Repair-and-Alteration Backlog
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wardrobe:item repair_needed=yes
| stats count as backlog, values(repair_type) as repair_types by category
| sort - backlog
description: Tracks garments waiting for hems, button fixes, tailoring, or other repairs before they can return to rotation.
value: A small repair backlog quietly turns usable clothing into dead inventory; this keeps those saves visible.
implementation: Mark repair-needed items in wardrobe inventory and summarize backlog by category and repair type.
visualization: Table of wardrobe repair backlog by category.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which clothes could be useful again if you finally fixed or altered them.
